test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Study the given bar graph and answer the question that follows.

The given bar graph shows the annual exam average marks for five sections of class XI in Biology, Mathematics and Chemistry. The maximum marks of each subject is 100.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7acfdd94741695eab9c77c3b33153614d3248e414a4c01fcfd2bf087507821f.png] 

Find the ratio between the average marks of five sections scored in Biology to the average marks scored in Chemistry.
solution:
**Calculation:**

Section A (Biology): 95

Section B (Biology): 90

Section C (Biology): 94

Section D (Biology): 88

Section E (Biology): 92

Sum of Biology marks = 95 + 90 + 94 + 88 + 92 = 459

Average marks in Biology = (459)/(5) = 91.8

Section A (Chemistry): 88

Section B (Chemistry): 95

Section C (Chemistry): 90

Section D (Chemistry): 94

Section E (Chemistry): 90

Sum of Chemistry marks = 88 + 95 + 90 + 94 + 90 = 457

Average marks in Chemistry = (457)/(5) = 91.4

Ratio = Average marks in Biology : Average marks in Chemistry

Ratio = 91.8 : 91.4

Ratio = 918 : 914

Ratio = (918)/(2) : (914)/(2)

Ratio = 459 : 457

(Note: 457 is a prime number, so the ratio cannot be simplified further.)

**∴ The ratio between the average marks of five sections scored in Biology to the average marks scored in Chemistry is 459 : 457.**
